Vanessa / Marissa —

Quick summary: SuperCarrier (logistics, enterprise) is asking for a deeper-than-standard discount on Hosted API usage to make the economics work for a multi-year deployment across their tracking and routing products. Their procurement and finance teams are pushing hard and have signaled a deadline for commercial terms by next Wednesday.

Why this matters:
- Committed usage: expected baseline 1.6B tokens/year in year 1, ramp to ~2.4B by year 3 per attached projection.
- Contract term: 3 years preferred by customer, with upfront commit in year 1.
- Strategic value: marquee logistics customer, potential to co-market and strengthen cloud partner plays (they run cross-border ops in US/EU).

Ask: Exec approval to offer a 30% list discount on Hosted API usage rates (above our standard tiered program) tied to a 3-year committed usage schedule and a non-refundable 12-month minimum payment. I believe the combination of volume and committed term justifies a steeper concession; if execs are uncomfortable with 30% we should consider 25% plus an onboarding credit or expanded contract term.

Attached: SOW v3 and usage projection.

If helpful I can hop on a quick sync with legal/procurement to sketch required clauses (data residency, audit logs).

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
